description: Coral Shading Protocol v5 light tables (forward Monte Carlo). Per unit downwelling irradiance just below a flat sea surface. Fournier-Forand phase function (n 1.10, mu 3.5835, bb/b 0.0183), delta-truncated at 3 deg; uniform sky; no bottom reflection. Beyond the last reliable depth of each run (n_photons x value >= min_tally) values follow asymptotic exponential decay with the angular shape fixed (see build_tables._extend).
